newsitem.title: HUNGARY: BorsodChem sells stake in plastics unit.
newsitem.headline: BorsodChem sells stake in plastics unit.

text.p: Hungarian chemicals company BorsodChem Rt announced the sale of its 50.2 percent stake in Miskolci Muanyagfeldolgozo Rt plastics company.
The sale was implemented on May 21, Borsodchem said without further details.
Miskolci Muanyagfeldolgozo has a registered capital of 520 million forints and produces plastic garden furniture, packaging means and plastics products for the contruction industry.
In 1996 it had sales of 1.23 billion forints of which almost 87 percent was generated on the Hungarian market.
